summary: Annovis Bio filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $21.0M underwritten follow-on: 19,000,000 common shares plus pre-funded warrants for up to 2,000,000 shares, each paired with one five-year warrant exercisable at $1.00. Combined price is $1.00 per share (or $0.9999 per pre-funded warrant) plus accompanying warrant; gross proceeds $20,999,800, underwriting discounts $1,202,500, net $19,797,300. Reference price was $1.09 on November 3, 2026. A director is buying 5,000,000 shares. This is a routine shelf capital raise, not a special situation; watch dilution and warrant overhang.
